name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with F1, fueled by late-night broadcasts and a passion for the intricate engineering behind each car. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before joining a smaller GT racing team as a junior engineer. His meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving skills quickly earned him recognition, and he steadily climbed the ranks.

As a chief engineer, Park believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing every aspect of the car's performance to identify areas for improvement. While his technical acumen is undeniable, he is also known for his demanding nature, pushing his team to strive for perfection. He is loyal to a fault, always putting the team's success above individual recognition.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze and perpetually tired eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking green tea, even in the pit lane during a race.
